topic: Day 48 — carousel — Breaking trust takes a moment, rebuilding it doesn't work on the same clock

slides.text: Rebuilding it doesn't work on the same clock.
Demanding fast forgiveness ignores what rebuilding requires.
No apology compresses that timeline, however sincere.

caption:
The time asymmetry between destroying trust in a moment and rebuilding it over months is real, and impatience with it makes things worse.

Follow for one of these a day.
